paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Judah kumpipa' inn ah hohsuk inla, hiai thu va gen in.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Inkuante Kiang A Jeremiah Thupuak
english: Yahweh said, “Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak this word there:

paite: 'Aw Judah kumpipa, David tutphah tung a tu, nang leh na nungzuite leh na mi hiai kongkhak a lutte toh, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un,' " chi in;
english: ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, king of Judah, who sits on David’s throne—you, your servants, and your people who enter in by these gates.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Diktak leh hoihtak in vai hawm unla; simmohmi khut a kipan loh thuakmi hunkhia unla; mikhualte, pa neiloute leh meithai tung ah diklouhna hiam hiamgamna hiam ching kei un; hiai mun ah mihoih sisan leng suah sam kei un.
english: Yahweh says: “Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor. Do no wrong. Do no violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Don’t shed innocent blood in this place.

paite: Hiai thu zui ngei hi le uchin zaw, David tutphah tung a kumpipate kangtalaite leh sakolte tung a tuang in, amaute, anungzuite uh leh amite uh hiai na inn kongkhakte ua lut ngeingei ding uh hiven.
english: For if you do this thing indeed, then kings sitting on David’s throne will enter in by the gates of this house, riding in chariots and on horses—they, their servants, and their people.

paite: Himahleh hiai thute na ngaihkhiak kei uleh, hiai inn asegawp ding a, chi in kei-le-kei kilou in ka kichiam ahi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by myself,” says Yahweh, “that this house will become a desolation.”’”

paite: TOUPA'N Judah kumpipa inkuan tungtang thu hichibang in agen hi: " 'Nang zaw kei a ding in Gilead bang, Lebanon mualvum bang na hi, hinapi in gamdai ka hon suaksak ding; luahmi om lou khopi bang mai in.
english: For Yahweh says concerning the house of the king of Judah: “You are Gilead to me, the head of Lebanon. Yet surely I will make you a wilderness, cities which are not inhabited.

paite: Nang hihmang dingte, galvan nei chiat in, ka bawlkhol ding a; na sidar sing telte aphuk ding ua, mei ah akhul ding uh."
english: I will prepare destroyers against you, everyone with his weapons, and they will cut down your choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.

paite: " ‘Huan nam tampite'n hiai khopi apal paisuak ding ua, michih in amau invengte kiang ah "TOUPA'N hiai khopi thupi mahmah bangziak a hichitak a hih hi ding ahia eita?" achi ding uh.
english: “Many nations will pass by this city, and they will each ask his neighbor, ‘Why has Yahweh done this to this great city?’

paite: A Pathian uh TOUPA thukhun alehngatsan ua pathian dangte abiak ua, a-nna asep ziak uh ahi, chi in adawng ding uh.’ "
english: Then they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh their God, worshiped other gods, and served them.’”

paite: Misi kah kei unla, suun sam kei un; paimangmi bel nakpi mahmah in kah un, ahong kik nawn kei ding a, apianna gam amuh nawn louh ding ziak in.
heading: Jehoahaz Tungtang A Jeremiah Thugen
english: Don’t weep for the dead. Don’t bemoan him; but weep bitterly for him who goes away, for he will return no more, and not see his native country.

paite: Judah kumpipa Shallum, Josiah sik a vaihawmpa, hiai mun a kipan paikheta tungtang thu bel TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Hiai ah ahong kik nawnta kei ding.
english: For Yahweh says touching Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, and who went out of this place: “He won’t return there any more.

paite: Sal a apina mun uah, huai mah ah asi ding a, hiai gam amu nawnta kei ding."
english: But he will die in the place where they have led him captive. He will see this land no more.”

paite: "Diktatlouhna a inn lam a, diklouhna a dantan tungnungte bawlmi, athawn a amah invengte tha zang, loh pe nuam lou mite tung agik hi;
heading: Jehoiakim Tungtang A Jeremiah Thugen
english: “Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his rooms by injustice; who uses his neighbor’s service without wages, and doesn’t give him his hire;

paite: 'Inn thupi mahmah ka kilam ding a, dantan tungnung zapite nei inn, tohlette ka hong ding a, sidar sing in ka thuapsuak ding a, zesan ka nuh ding,' chimi tung mah.
english: who says, ‘I will build myself a wide house and spacious rooms,’ and cuts out windows for himself, with a cedar ceiling, and painted with red.

paite: Sidar sing a na ten ziak in, kumpipa kisa na hi maw! Na pa'n ne in adawn a, diktak in vai ahawm kei maw? Huai amah a ding in ahoih ahi.
english: “Should you reign because you strive to excel in cedar? Didn’t your father eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? Then it was well with him.

paite: Migenthei leh tasamte vai ahawmsak a, huai ahoih ahi. Hiaitak na hon theihdan ding ahi maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; so then it was well. Wasn’t this to know me?” says Yahweh.

paite: 'Himahleh na huaihamte a ding in, mihoih sisan suahna ding, nuaisiahna ding leh hiamgamna ding lel in na mit leh na lungsim na pu ahi.' "
english: But your eyes and your heart are only for your covetousness, for shedding innocent blood, for oppression, and for doing violence.”

paite: Huaiziak in Judahte kumpipa Jehoiakim, Josiah tapa tungthu bel TOUPA'N hichi in agen a; " 'Aw ka unaupa,' chi in hiam, 'Aw ka sanggampa,' chi in hiam amah asuun kei ding ua, 'Aw toupa,' chi in hiam, 'Aw thupipen,' chi in hiam amah asuun sam kei ding uh.
english: Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: “They won’t lament for him, saying, ‘Ah my brother!’ or, ‘Ah sister!’ They won’t lament for him, saying ‘Ah lord!’ or, ‘Ah his glory!’

paite: Jerusalem kulh polam a lotkhiak a, paih in, sabiltung vui in avui ding uh.
english: He will be buried with the burial of a donkey, drawn and cast out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.”

paite: Lebanon ah paitou inla, kikou in, Bashan ah na aw suah inla, Abarim a pan in kikou in, na itte tengteng amangthangta ua.
heading: Jerusalem Tuah Ding A Genkholhna
english: “Go up to Lebanon, and cry out. Lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim; for all your lovers have been destroyed.

paite: Na lohchin in na kiang ah thu ka gen a, nang lah ka ngaikhe kei ding, na chi a, ka kamsuak ngaihkhiak louh na tuailai kipan in hiai na omdan ahi.
english: I spoke to you in your prosperity, but you said, ‘I will not listen.’ This has been your way from your youth, that you didn’t obey my voice.

paite: Na belampute tengteng uh huih in akivak ding ua, na mi itte sal in atang ding ua, nang leng gitlouhna tengteng ziak in zahlaktak leh mangbangtak in na om ngei ding hi.
english: The wind will feed all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity. Surely then you will be ashamed and confounded for all your wickedness.

paite: Aw Lebanon tang a teng, sidar sing lak a buseptu na tung a natna atun a na hong hehpihhuai ding dan mai zaw! numei nauvei na bang mai in."
english: Inhabitant of Lebanon, who makes your nest in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied you will be when pangs come on you, the pain as of a woman in travail!

paite: Ahin a ka hin sung, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; Judah kumpipa Koniah, Jehoiakim tapa bel ka khut taklam a sawnna zungbuh himah lechin, huai a kipan ka hon botkhe ngeingei ding.
heading: Jehoiachin Tung A Pathian Thukhenna
english: “As I live,” says Yahweh, “though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet on my right hand, I would still pluck you from there.

paite: Thah ding a nang hon zongmi khut ah, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut ah leh Kaldaite khut ah ngeingei nang ka hon pe ding hi.
english: I would give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of them of whom you are afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

paite: Na pianna hilou gamdang ah nang leh na nu nang hon suangtu ka hon paikhe ding a, huai ah na si ding uh.
english: I will cast you out with your mother who bore you into another country, where you were not born; and there you will die.

paite: Alungsim ua kik nawn a-utna mahmah gam uah akik nawn kei ding uh.
english: But to the land to which their soul longs to return, there they will not return.”

paite: Hiai Koniah pen bel kitamgawp, simmohhuai ahi kei a hia? Bel asung a lungkimna omlouhna ahi kei maw? Bangziak a amah leh asuante paihkhiak a gam atheih ngei louh ua paihkhiak a a-om uh?
english: Is this man Coniah a despised broken vessel? Is he a vessel in which no one delights? Why are they cast out, he and his offspring, and cast into a land which they don’t know?

paite: Aw, gam, gam, gam, TOUPA thu ngai in,
english: O earth, earth, earth, hear Yahweh’s word!

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiai mi ta nei lou, adamsung a lohching lou ding mi ahi, asuante kuamah lohching a, David tutphah tung a tu ding leh Judah gam a vaihawm nawn ding a-om kei ding uh, chi in gelh in.
english: Yahweh says, “Record this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his days; for no more will a man of his offspring prosper, sitting on David’s throne and ruling in Judah.”
